import hashlib

def authenticate_user(username, password_submission):
    data_source = {
        "u_123": ("1a2b3c", "382e70a38cba570851871a39626c1b3518344e637851859c2980e551b8a53e36"),
        "u_456": ("4d5e6f", "d6e3c5a61e68c92e1b30349b1a1a22143009f427f0015560b370605a41d9dfc2")

    salt_val, stored_val = data_source[username]
    
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    h.update(salt_val.encode('utf-8'))
    h.update(password_submission.encode('utf-8'))
    computed_val = h.hexdigest()

    return computed_val == stored_val
